tasks.title: Setup PostgreSQL database schema with all tables (users, study_notes, study_groups, group_members, group_messages, note_ratings) and relationships
Implement user registration and authentication API endpoints with JWT, email verification, and password hashing
Configure AWS S3 bucket for file storage and implement secure file upload/download endpoints with URL generation
Build study notes CRUD API endpoints including upload, browse with filters, search by subject/title, and download tracking
Implement study groups API endpoints for create, join, list groups with subject filtering and member management
Integrate Socket.io for real-time group chat with message history, typing indicators, and message persistence
Design and implement mobile-responsive React UI for Home Dashboard, Browse Notes, and Note Detail screens with navigation
Design and implement Study Groups and Group Chat screens with real-time message rendering and user interactions
Build User Profile screen with stats display, uploaded notes management, and settings navigation
Implement rating and review system API endpoints and UI components (deferred to post-MVP if time constrained)
Create reusable UI component library (buttons, cards, inputs, avatars, navigation) following design system specifications
Integrate frontend with backend APIs, implement JWT token management, and handle authentication flows
Perform end-to-end testing of critical user flows: registration, note upload/download, group creation, and chat messaging
Deploy MVP to staging environment, configure environment variables, and conduct final smoke testing

risks: AWS S3 integration complexity and file upload size limits may delay note sharing functionality
Socket.io real-time messaging scalability issues with multiple concurrent group chats could impact performance
University email verification system may require additional third-party service integration not initially scoped
Mobile responsiveness across different devices and browsers may require additional testing and refinement time
Database query performance for note search and filtering may degrade with large datasets without proper indexing
